notes.title: Hajji tours 0.5 - Omra & Mecca
notes.content:
Hey,

We are so happy to introduce the first learning module in Hajji tours !
It is now possible to perform the Omra like if you was there with more than 6 languages !

They could have some small issues about the loading, please wait a little time even if the loader is fully finished. It will not impact your learning session in game !

Thank you very much for your great support and please come say hi in our discord channel !
